title: POS vs FLU for First Line Treatment of Coccidioidomycosis (Study P04558Am1)(COMPLETED)
brief_summary: To evaluate the safety of posaconazole (POS) in the treatment of coccidioidomycosis. Period A consisted of 2 blinded arms, posaconazole and fluconazole. Recruitment was stopped, and participants in Period A may have been eligible to roll over to an open-label, non-comparitive Period B. During Period B, participants received posaconazole for a treatment duration not to exceed 12 months.
